iOS notification polish

Clearer delivery settings, readable messages, and reliable recovery when the connection fails.

After-only simulator evidence

iPhone 16 Pro, iOS 26.5. The inbox uses XXX Large text and a simulated failed refresh. Settings uses the existing paused-account fixture; its missing preference endpoint deliberately remains visible as a reloadable error. No matched comparison is claimed: the existing fixture clock changes between captures, and the inbox fixture was added during this pass.

What changed, and why

Read status survives uncertain responses

Was

Concurrent actions could restore stale snapshots after a failed response.

Now

Writes serialize, update after success, and reread the server after uncertainty. Large-inbox Undo respects the API request limit.

Messages and recovery stay readable

Was

Bodies stopped after two lines, banners covered rows, and large text truncated the title.

Now

Full messages wrap, feedback reserves space, and the labeled bulk-read icon preserves the title.

Delivery language describes what is known

Was

Registration read Ready, the test implied delivery, and the primer promised unsupported broadcasts.

Now

Settings identifies quiet delivery and registration separately. Test success means Apple accepted the push. Primer copy matches implemented producers.

Reminders and broadcasts retain their destination

Was

Repeated snooze identifiers nested, scheduling could race sign-out, and blast inbox payloads lost their destination.

Now

Reminders retain routing context and stable identifiers with session cleanup. Blast archive taps return to the Home acknowledgment banner.

Verification

  • 120 notification and transport contract tests passed across 19 files.
  • Eight native notification tests passed on the required iPhone 16 Pro in an isolated copy, including committed-write/lost-response recovery, duplicate action protection, paging overlap, 1,001-item undo, snooze identity, blast decoding and rendered recovery.
  • Wisconsin app compiled for the simulator; existing notification-settings UI test passed. TypeScript, focused lint, documentation verification and diff whitespace checks passed.

Things to know

  • The normal native test bundle is blocked by pre-existing ScheduleDateMathTests fixture initializer errors. Focused tests used an isolated copy with only NotificationInboxTests in the test target; product notification sources are unchanged between that copy and this checkout.
  • No real push was sent. Physical lock-screen delivery, permission changes, snooze execution, blast acknowledgment, authenticated lifecycle and VoiceOver acceptance remain unverified. No commit, deployment or distribution was performed.
